DIAGNOSIS READY: Seborrheic Dermatitis (specifically Infantile Cradle Cap).

The combination of greasy yellow scales, distribution on the scalp and forehead, family history of psoriasis, and onset in a 3-month-old strongly supports this diagnosis.
